area: Keystone testbed: enemy idle clips in an HP-keyed blend space

find.report_claim: animation_blend was one of 21 Keystone modules the shooter had never imported, while it already ships four .kanim idle clips and publishes every enemy's HP in enemies.json
find.live_evidence: the game sampled one fixed idle clip per enemy type; no AI/soak consumer could ask for a blended pose representing the current alive threat
find.consumer_evidence: BlendSpace1D orders the shipped clips at thresholds 20/30/120/600 (wisp/mite/brute/warden), samples by max alive enemy HP and reports a JSON-safe pose; to_dict/from_dict reproduce an equal space

read: shooter/anim.py: TYPES and four loaded idle clips
killed: writing the blended pose to a scene node: that would change presentation state per call and risk the sim hash; the report stays pure JSON
thresholds from score instead of HP: score is a reward value, not threat; used as the mutation target to prove the test catches a wrong field
comparing clips at time 0: all four idle clips are identity at t=0, so the distinctness tests sample at t=0.7 where the poses actually differ
analyze.survivor: an on-demand enemy_blend_report() keyed by shipped HP, with boundary sampling, document round-trip and a JSON pose summary

fix.shooter: shooter/game.py imports BlendSample/BlendSpace1D and TYPES, and adds enemy_blend_report(parameter=None, time=0.0) with a default parameter from the highest alive enemy HP; tests/test_keystone_animation_blend_mechanics.py (5 tests) pins thresholds, exact endpoint clips, mid-blend difference, threat-driven default and sim isolation; README testbed matrix and tree name the consumer and test

shooter.failing_first: all 5 new tests failed before the consumer existed (ShooterGame has no enemy_blend_report)
shooter.own_test_bugs: two first-draft assertions compared a nested pose key incorrectly and sampled all clips at t=0 where every idle pose is identity; corrected to compare ['pose']['subject'] at t=0.7
shooter.measured: thresholds [20,30,120,600], sample at 75/0.7 gives rotation [0.999808,0,-0.019624,0] and scale 1.033313; round_trip True
shooter.mutation: using score instead of HP for thresholds fails 3 of 5 tests; game.py restored byte-identically (sha256 089c17ba5fc2f9584d8f09eb8c243cc711d792e3723b25e39292fb2a7a1cfe34)
shooter.codebase_map: regenerated after the new imports, method and test module
